transcript: Yesterday, I saw Sunset Baby at Signature Theatre, a play by Dominique Morisseau. It’s only been in previews for a week, but it's in really good shape and the performances and relationships between characters feel really authentic and the writing I thought was exquisite. There are only three characters: a woman named Nina, her father, and her boyfriend / business partner Damon. Nina and her father both have some unresolved feelings around Nina's now deceased mother who raised Nina while her father was in prison for most of her childhood and they're actually reconnecting for the first time during this play. It’s about accountability and regret and parenthood and hindsight — it's complicated and it's painful but this play was really poignant and well done so I would definitely recommend. I believe it is running through early March. With that, another program for my collection.
